avis.texte: Such a great product! Love the easy to use packaging. Great for my sensitive skin and leaves my face soft. It's a nice consistency that is not too thick or thin.

avis.titre: It's a great simple nighttime serum if you're look
avis.texte: I've been using Cetaphil Repair & Renew Serum PM for a while now and really like how gentle yet effective it is. It feels lightweight on the skin, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any sticky residue. After a few nights of use, my skin looks more hydrated, smoother, and a bit more even in tone. I also appreciate that it's fragrance-free and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin at all.
I really like this serum. It's very soothing and gentle on the skin even when I feel irritated. This serum is perfect for night skin because it keeps skin plump.

It's been a few weeks since I start using this serum and I have nothing but positive thoughts about it! It's a very kind product with the skin (if you have sensitive skin you're safe) it feels so good into the skin and helps to improve the texture and uneven tones. The packaging it's ergonomic and functional… it's simple but worth it. I love it using it at nights and you're able to feel a softer and more radiant skin in the morning!
I think this PM serum is doing wonders for my skin. I wake up feeling so moisturized. It leaves my skin looking glowy and dewy. It's unscented and I love the packaging!

The Cetaphil repair and renew serum p.m. feels lightweight and gentle on my skin, and I like that it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. It works well as a nighttime serum and doesn't irritate my skin. Well, I didn't see dramatic results overnight, my skin felt more hydrated and calm by the morning. It's a solid, no frills option for nighttime repair, especially if you prefer fragrance free skin care.
This pm serum is fantastic I put it on at night after doing my skin care routine in the shower and it moisturized my face but have also cleared up a lot of the texture as well

I really love the consistency of this serum! It's thick and cream, but it isn't sticky like other serums, and hasn't clogged my pores! It also absorbs int the skin super fast and doesn't pill with other products

Stings my face a little bit. Don't know if it is more hydrating than the usual cetaphil moisturizers I've been using, but it seems to do OK under my heavier moisturizer. Haven't seen much of a difference in skin quality.

I've decided to work this into my skincare routine for the past few weeks and to my surprise, I LOVE! this combined with the morning serum had made my skin look so hydrated and glowy, it's absolutely amazing! my skin feels / looks smoother and it goes on with SUCH ease! i actually look forward to putting this on 😆😋 Definitely a great product.
Cetaphil is a good brand for skincare. first time using it. it wasnt bad. No breakouts or irriatation. hydrating and packaging is nice. I would buy it again
This serum feels lightweight and get into the skin easily. I love the bottle, looks just perfect for the quality of the product. My skin looks brighter and more even.

I have been testing out this product for quite a while to gauge how I really feel about it because my skin can be quite sensitive. This product has a subtle moisturizing effect that isn't too strong to the point of causing bad breakouts. This product makes a good addition to your night time post shower routine, it does not burn when applying it, it does feel slightly tightening, but nothing harsh or drying. I would recommend it to my friends who experience sensitivity to harsh skincare products because this one was gentle enough for my skin to not cause any redness, burning or irritation, and that's very important to me.

This repair and and renew serum is the truth!! Using this alongside the advanced daily defense serum has truly done wonders for my skin's health and glow. They're both relatively lightweight so it doesn't take very long to absorb into the skin. The first picture represents day one of me using the products and the last picture shows my results two weeks later.

I was gifted this Cetaphil Advanced Daily Defense Serum in exchange for my honest review. I can't say enough good things about this extremely versatile serum. It's designed for even the most sensitive and stressed skin, both of which I have. I love that this serum isn't oily, greasy, or heavy. It absorbs right into my skin with no residue and immediately helps my skin look healthy, moisturized, and radiant. My fine lines on my forehead and cheeks are continuously diminishing the more I use it and overall my skin's texture is much more smooth with my once terribly large pores now nearly non-existent. I'm excited to see continuing positive changes in my skin since beginning use, but overall right now, my skin is so much more vibrant, healthy, and hydrated with a natural shiny, glow to it.
always happy with cetaphil! the packaging feels expensive and this wasnt too over complicated for my skin. a nice night time serum - the glass bottle keeps the product feeling fresh
Love these! The texture is lightweight and serum like. It lasts all day and makes my skin feel soft and plump. Very easy to layer with other products and combine.

Totally transformed my skin! Wow this stuff is extremely slept on. My skin is so soft and supple after using this for a couple of weeks. I noticed my skin looks morelively and retains moisture during this dry transition from winter to spring. I love the dropper as well. I hate having to use my fingers to get product out of a container.
I love everything about this serum from the consistency of it to the design of the packing and not to mention the amazing ingredients of this serums. I love it.
Night repair and renew serum. Packaging very put together so the glass container won't break. It's a big amount for the price so yea you get enough and pay little. Not too expensive!

Makes my skin feel more protected in this Florida heat but also feels pretty nourishing. I feel like it's made my pores. Look a bit smaller as well. Formula is very lightweight and easy to go on and the dropper bottle is really easy to use. Soaks into the skin very fast so you don't have to wait up to go to bed has niacinamide and triple hyaluronic acid.

Amazing ingredients in this serum and very gentle on the skin! I love the blue bottle for nighttime. The ingredients have really helped my skin and make this serum very effective. It's overall hydrating, helps target anti-aging, and repairs the skin. Really amazing. I love that it's not harsh and I have noticed zero side effects. It gets absorbed very quickly into the skin.

I really liked this product! I used it in the evening times, and it made my skin feel hydrated and moisturized. My skin absorbed it quickly. It also did not make me break out. It's great for sensitive skin.
No scent. Cute packaging. It is milky and hydrating. I prefer this over the day time formula. I don't see any real difference over a 30 day period but worth a shot

avis.titre: Dewy look but not sure on repair
avis.texte: Leaves my skin feeling rejuvenated. Has a milky texture and doesn't dry to fast. However, I did not notice a difference in my skin. Packaging feels luxe.

I absolutely love this product love the texture of it. I love how it makes my skin, super shiny and glowing and I overall definitely see a difference in my skin barrier using this. I will absolutely continue using this. There's really no smell at all and no skin irritation caused from this.

Since receiving this product, I've used it consistently in conjunction with the AM serum. I can confidently say I've noticed a significant difference in the brightness, texture, and firmness of my skin. The dropper applicator makes this easy to use. It doesn't feel heavy or greasy on my oily, sensitive, acne prone skin. Regardless of this receiving this for free, I will 100% repurchase and continue to use this as my part of daily skin care routine. I've honestly fallen in love with these two products! Cetaphil really put their all into these two products. I feel like they can be used with any skin type!! Absolutely recommend!

I was really excited to try the product, however, I only got to use it for two weeks. Seasonal allergies started and my skin got super sensitive so I had to pause the use because I didn't want to guess if it was my skin reacting or the product itself. For those two weeks I had no issues at all with this product I love that it doesn't have a strong scent and was gentle on my skin I will update my review once I have a chance to start using it again

I have been loving incorporating the Cetaphil repair and renew PM serum. After cleansing my skin at night and cleaning it away from all the dirt and sweat from the entire day. Applying this serum makes my skin feel refresh and relaxed. The serum soaks up nicely not feeling tacky at the end. My skin feels tight and firm as if it was setting back into place.

avis.titre: Instant radiance and softness at night
avis.texte: From the very first use, since I have dry skin, I saw my skin looking incredible, very radiant. In the mornings, my skin woke up amazing, and together with the day serum, they made a combo that I didn't expect to be so perfect. I feel my skin smoother, and it's has also helped with redness and some marks I had.

2 weeks of using this serum and so far my skin loves it. There is no scent. It soaks so fast on the skin. There is no residue. Being 9 months pregnant I can pretty safely say this is perfect for sensitive skin.

I liked how smooth it was, I did tend to get a bit of redness in my more sensitive areas but that went away eventually. I'm thinking my skin just wasn't used to it. It absorbed nicely and got rid of some dryness for me.
I really liked using this Repair and Renew PM serum! It felt nice on my face and went on smoothly. It didnt leave my face feeling greasy and it helped hydrate my skin
As someone with a detailed skincare regime, I was pleasantly impressed with this product. My skin immediately felt hydrated and plump. A little goes a long way so this will last awhile.
This has become my nightly staple! I love how my skin feels directly after application and how it looks after waking up! Super glowy, dewy, & moisturized.

Cetaphil Repair & Renew Serum works to hydrate skin and provide even skin tone. The product is powered by Gallic-AOX TM (antioxidant complex), Hyaluronic Acid (hydration), and Pro-Vitamin B5 (moisture retention) I apply this serum in the evening on my face. The formula is lightweight, fragrance free and absorbs well. My skin feels moisturized and smooth. I highly recommend this product to everyone!
Affordable price, suitable for oily skin, mild fragrance, does not irritate the skin. My skins looks improved after using the serum cetaphil repair
I love this product. It makes my skin so hydrated and it has took a lot of redness away!! I love the feel and results of the AM and PM serums. I didnt have a problem and I have very sensitive skin.

The Cetaphil Repair & Renew PM Serum comes with a doppler which keeps the serum hygienic. I distribute one pump of it into my hands and pat it evenly over my face every night. The PM serum is milkier than the AM serum but the formulation is similar. It dries quickly and has left my skin smoother and plumper with consistent use but I haven't noticed any reduction in redness from the centella asiatica. For the price I would consider this serum a good value.
Love the feel and the no reaction to my skin make the appearance feels great and great for any skin type love the after feel and of course it's effective
Love the bright blue bottle and packaging. This serum feels wonderful on my skin and I enjoyed adding it to my nighttime routine. No irritation.
This serum does feel really lightweight and nice on my skin, however, after using it for a week, my skin was getting irritated. I don't think it's the best for sensitive skin.

I have issues with acne and super dry skin. I've been trying different products to help fix my skin barrier and this by far has been the best! It doesn't make your skin feel greasy and it has really helped my skin not be dry and flaky anymore! Highly recommend for anyone with skin barrier issues! No scent to it.

I've been using the Cetaphil Repair & Renew Serum PM for a few weeks and it fits really well into my nighttime skincare routine. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. A small amount spreads easily and covers the whole face. My skin stays hydrated overnight and feels soft and refreshed in the morning. It's fragrance free and gentle, which is great for sensitive skin. After consistent use my skin looks smoother,calmer and more hydrated. Overall, it's a simple but effective serum for nighttime repair.

This looks like it would be very wet on the skin but absorbs quite well leaving skin super hydrated. I dont know that I saw any immediate changes but my skin certainly felt more hydrated and plump when I use it daily.

I enjoyed the PM Serum and it's milky consistency. The blue bottle keeps the serum from getting ruined by the sun and the dropper gives an easy application. I would have liked a little more moisture for a night time serum, but it wasn't sticky and dried quickly. No scent to the product which I appreciate.
I appreciate products that don't break me out. This gives me a hydrating boost. I really like how my skin looks after using this. I'm sure after continued use I will see more improvement over time!

avis.titre: A light  night serum  that absorbs quickly,  moist
avis.texte: I was pleasantly surprised by the serum, it was my first time using it. It has a light consistency and is easy to apply to the skin. It absorbs quickly and leaves the skin feeling soft and not dry, which is very good. I used it for a couple of days and liked it. It's a good serum for night time care and moisturizes well after a hard days work. I recommend it🫶🏻

This serum is really nice. The packaging is high quality making it easy to apply. It absorbs intp the skin quickly and doesn't irritate my skin at all. Keeps my skin feeling plump instead of tight and dry
This Cetaphil repair and renew serum from Cetaphil is really a great serum that helped my skin concerns and redness . Made my skin look more even and smoother
This is a great serum for night time, it helps a lot with renewing your skin and leaves you with a soft and flawless skin. I love how quick my skin absorbs this formula!

This serum works really well. After using it for a few weeks I have noticed that my acne has cleared up and that my skin is more moisturized. This is a great value for money and the serum does not irritate my sensitive skin.
The Repair & Renew Serum is easy to use and smoothly blends into my skin after application. It easily absorbs and feels fresh as well. The packaging looks classy and speaks to the uses of the serum.

I renewed my night routine with this Cetapil repair and renew serum PM. It has best feeling after using this serum, it absorbs so quickly by clapping your fingers on your face. I don't have greasiness at all, so I have no idea how it will be for oily skin, But truly, it is best for normal/dry skin!

I really like this as a way to add extra hydration. It's not enough on its own, but it has worn well under my other eye creams and moisturizers. The formula is thick enough that droplets hold their shape, so they don't drop away if you put one or two drops on your fingertips.
I do love the feel of texture of my skin after using these both. But I don't think that these are given me any noticeable difference in my skin appearance

I've been using this product for a couple weeks now. It's nice but I haven't noticed a change in my skin long term yet. Immediately after applying it does add visible hydration which was hard to capture in the photos. The serum absorbs nicely and layers well under makeup and other skincare products

avis.titre: A lightweight nighttime serum that hydrates, absor
avis.texte: I've been using the Cetaphil repair & renew serum pm and I really like how gentle and lightweight it feels on my skin. The texture absorbs quickly and does leave any greasy or sticky residue, which makes it perfect for nighttime routine. After applying it, my skin feels instantly hydrated and smooth. Over time I've also noticed my skin looking a little more radiant and balanced. I appreciate that it's designed for sensitive skin and doesn't cause irritation, which is important for me when trying new skincare products. Overall, it's a nice nighttime serum that adds hydration and helps my skin feel softer and healthier without feeling heavy on the skin.
I love this product! It makes my skin feel very hydrated and absorbs really well while still leaving my skin feeling moisturized. It hasn't broken out my skin and isn't irritated

The cetaphil repair & renew PM serum is just as good as the AM and when paired together they are amazing! It is lightweight, gentle, and super hydrating. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling soft and refreshed by morning. Perfect for sensitive skin and a great addition to a nighttime routine. I used it consecutively for a couple weeks and my skin is a lot more smooth and skin tone is more even! Definitely recommend!
I've been using the Cetaphil Repair and Renew Serum for a month now and am having great results. My skin has smoothed out even more, and I feel like I started getting a natural glow.

I've received this product for free from Influesnter in return for my honest review. I've been using this serum for about 2 weeks and I can say that I've seen some improvement in the dark spots. The texture is milky and can be absorbed instantly. However, I didn't notice that my face is moisturized in the next day so I'm following with a moisturizer. I love that this product got 93/100 ok Yuka which indicates that it is really safe to use if on your skin from the ingredients perspective. I will continue using this product.

I loved the syringe that makes application easy. The liquid is not thick which makes application easy! Alot goes a long ways when applying to face and it leaves my face feeling soft! The scent is not too strong.

Absolutely loving this new serum. It's now a part of my nighttime routine. It provides hydration, the vitamin e helps target dark spots. I'd definitely recommend. Doesn't leave an oily residue or redness. Easily drop bottle to dispense

Cetaphil Repair and Renew Serum (PM) is a great addition to your nightly routine as the seasons change and your skin's craving some consistency. I love how hydrating the serum feels and how I wake up with my skin feeling soft. Combining with the AM is a must! This is lightly scented and soaks in easily.

It comes out of the bottle, extremely easy with the dobber and goes on very easy and smooth. It is extremely light and doesn't make me feel oily or like I have a product on my face. My skin feels nice and refreshed by the morning but I don't see a huge difference within 2 weeks, will keep using it though

This is the perfect night serum. It makes my evening skincare routine so much simpler and easier. It makes my skin so smooth and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. Not uncomfortable and doesn't leave any weird residue. I have seen a noticeable difference in my skin. I will continue to use this serum!
I have loved using this Cetaphil PM Serum. I have struggled with dry skin and this has been hydrating and wonderful for my skin. I will definitely keep using this.

This is the PM serum. This serum helps with repair and renewal. It helps repair my skin in 1 use. It plumps and visibly hydrates my skins barrier. The packaging is easy to use. I like the dropper that comes with it. It gives me the right amount of product for each use. It does pill or give me any breakouts. It doesn't feel heavy or sticky. It resolves when my skin feels dry and itchy. It helps with redness and helps my skin feel firmer. Helps with a gentle touch of vitamin E and Gallic acid that adsorbs quickly and very evenly. It also has vitamin B5, Hyaluronic Acid, CICA, and Bifida Ferment each ingredient helps plump and evens out skin tone and texture. I'm impressed with how my skin looks and feels at night.
The packaging is a 10 out of 10 . Love the texture and color of pm serum . Great with other products. Don't have a greasy feel likes thick but smooth at the same time it melt in your skin .
I love a good serum and I have tried quite a few over the years but this one is amazing it moisturizes my face without making it feel greasy and weighed down nor does it cause breakouts with my skin
I'm not going to lie, I am terrible at remembering to use this everyday, so I feel like I can't give a good review. I do like using it, but I need to be more consistent.

Absolutely amazing at hydrating my skin after a long day of makeup, washing, ect. This is a creamy non tacky texture that my skin just soaked right up. I pair this with the Am serum as well and my skin has never looked better. It has a dryer texture especially in the winter. This is great for hydrating, and has been a lot better on my skin than another brand product. This has not given me any new breakouts since usage.
This does not bother my sensitive skin i see visible smoother skin and less breakouts. It dires quickly and leaves no residue on my skin so greasy feeling. Not a strong scent it does not bother me.

I noticed a difference in my skin after the first use. I woke up the next morning and my skin felt so soft i was blown away by it. This serum goes on so smooth and absorbs into the skin pretty quick. Other skincare products layer beautifully on top of this serum. The bottle is glass and feels high end.
I noticed a difference after a few days my skin is sometimes to dry or oily but this made it feel shower soft. I liked that it wasn't to heavy and my pillow was clean

This PM serum works great and pairs great with the AM serum. It dries down pretty fast and I can sleep comfortably. Overall it's a great product that has helped my skin.
No harsh gross residue easy application you can see a difference after a few applications it feels amazing hydration smooth as silk texture just amazing

I was super excited to receive this set and to give it a try! I have dry skin and this set is woking amazing for my ten. I am using it for more than a month and Its one of my favorites so far. The Pm serum is working amazingly , very moisturizing and makes my skin feel veery light and smooth all night long. When washing my face in the morning the skin looks moisturized and fresh. Works great together with the Am serum. Im considering continue using it in the future! Definitely recommend it !
This produce was very nice and thick. When I put it on it took awhile to soak in which isn't bad for a night one. It made my skin very soft to the touch.

This is now my go to nighttime serum! After using it for a month, my skin feels softer and my makeup goes on smoother. I have next to no breakouts! I like how easy it is to put on. I only wish there were instructions/recommendations for what moisturizer would compliment the serum. Highly recommend! It's great you can use it night or day!

This repair and renew serum works great. No breakouts on my face. It makes your face smooth and no oily look. Comes in easy to dispense bottle. I love this serum. Only used a couple of weeks so far and already tell a difference

I used this products for 2 weeks to write this review. I don't use serum in my nighttime routine but this one surprised me a lot It has changed my skin a lot since I started using it daily It's didn't irritate me; it's very effective and necessary in the nighttime routine It' leaves a perfect feeling on the face.

avis.titre: Drying for me but will be excellent for others
avis.texte: I love its milky qualities, I love the glass packaging and how it feels cool and luxurious on the skin. The application and dispensing were simple and wonderful. I don't think Gallic acid and my skin get along or I would give it more stars but for me the am/pm serums were too drying.

This night serum is quite good; Cetaphil is one of the safe brands I can use since I suffer from quite a few allergies. This repairing serum helps the skin rebuild itself overnight. It absorbs quickly; to apply, wash your face thoroughly and dry it beforehand. It has a pleasant scent.
Works amazingly on the skin, especially in the night time. It's very revitalizing and prevents breakouts. I would definitely recommend. Amazing serum
I feel like this did nothing for my skin but made it feel sticky although the packaging is nice and it comes in a glass bottle. Its very easy to use im not sure it is for sensitive skin

I love Cetaphil in general but my. Skin doesn't like the skincare from this brand. I have been using the PM serum and it irritated my skin and active my rosacea a little bit. I think it doesn't go with my skin.

avis.titre: More hydrated, plump, and even tone! The results s
avis.texte: I used this serum for over a month. It was the only night serum I used along with my standard toner/essence/moisturizer routine. It made my skin feel so hydrated and I think you can see the difference in the pictures. The first picture (straight hair) was taken the first night I used this serum. The second photo (curly hair with the blue bottle shown) my skin looks so much more plump, healthy, and honestly looks more even in tone. The two photos were taken in the exact same spot with identical lighting. I am thoroughly impressed with how well this serum (and the am serum I tested along with it) worked and made my skin better over this month. I am certainly impressed.

I applied this product to clean skin before applying moisturizer (from a different brand) each night. Unsure if the two products didn't pair well or what, but it didn't feel there was sufficient absorption of either. Instead, it felt like my nighttime routine sloughed off my face in the shower each morning. The serum texture is sticky, which feels cheap? But it didn't cause irritation, so I suppose it worked just fine. I do like the intuitive color coding of the AM and PM serums!

avis.titre: soothing and nice to add to a routine
avis.texte: These serums definitely reduce redness and dryness, but after using for almost a month consistently, i do not think it prevents breakouts or helps with fine lines very much. at first, the products tingled after applying, but it tingled less the more i used them and thankfully it didn't irritate my skin. i just don't believe it did much overall by itself. i do solely use these products besides cleansing my face and moisturizer and spf for mornings. even by itself, it does leave a nice glow to the skin which i like!
I really like this product and I love this brand. I would definitely recommend the product, it doesn't make my skin breakout and absorbs into my skin very nicely.

This serum is formulated for sensitive skin and nighttime use. It absorbs nicely and doesn't leave a sticky or greasy film. It effectively strengthens the skin barrier and hydrates to plump and even skin tone. It contains a few anti-aging powerhouses and is a great value for the money. I would definitely buy this again.

The packaging is very nice, the performance is okay.. it made my skin break pretty bad. I never had this issue with any serum before. Once I used this I started breaking, I have sensitive skin too, and applying it on my skin felt dry. I applied it on my hand, first it looks very hydrated then it dries down and it's pretty dry

They are great! Very moisturizing but it does not leave the skin sticky. There isn't a scent which I particularly really like, and the application is so nice too, super smooth. It's a glass bottle, so it gives off high end. Love it
I've been loving the consistency and feeling this gives my skin every night as I prep for bed. I feel like this gives me less of dry skin when I wake!

I've been using this at night (you can use it day or night though) and I'm really liking it for the nights I don't use tret. It's calming and gentle, but makes me feel like my skin is healthy and hydrated. Overall, I was looking for a softer evening serum and this is perfect.

avis.texte: I'll start off by sharing my favorite things about this product. The consistency is smooth and not greasy and does not leave a cakey feeling residue on my face when I go to sleep. It's a calming, hydrating serum that doesn't irritate my sensitive skin like many anti aging products do. I felt like it was a good moisturizing product but I can't say I noticed a huge difference in a reduction of fine lines and wrinkles.

Overall this is a fairly good serum. It feels light on the skin, it moisturizes, and it doesn't cause any irritation. My skin soaked it up without any issues. But I didn't see much of a difference in my skin beyond being more moisturized.
Cetaphil's repair & renew serum has been a great addition to my daily night routine. Light and is quickly absorbed, almost instantly. It's not greasy or sticky, it's thick watery. No scent.

I looooved this paired with the am one. My forehead had a little bit of wrinkles now there is way fewer. My forehead looks and feels firmer. It's easy to apply with the dropper helps so you don't use as much
Very nice texture and leaves the skin nice and supple I like the stickiness of it and how it leaves it feeling glowy and pretty . Not to tight feeling on the skin

I love Cetaphil because it works so well with my sensitive skin. This is so hydrating and absorbs so well into my skin. It doesn't leave it feeling greasy at all like some serums do. It's also so affordable compared to other brands.

At night I like to really focus on hydrating my skin on non exfoliating days. Not only do i have to repair my skin from tretinoin but from the cold weather as well. After using this serum for a few weeks I noticed my skin feeling more plump and hydrated.
Word good. My skin feels so much better and healthier. It is effective and my skin feels tighter. My skin doesn't feel as dry. Good value. My skin wasn't irritated with this product.

I LOVE this serum! I'm not one who usually uses serums, however I have found my skin had been dry during the winter. This definitely helps restore the skin barrier and makes my skin feel and look more glowy and moisturized!

avis.titre: Love the new repair and renew serum

I've noticed a big change in my face; my face is more hydrated, smoother and has more shine. It really contains ingredients that benefit your face. It leaves no residue, and it absorbs really well
I love this serum. It is very boosting and helps with skin repairZ I really like it and think it is so good and red foment for anyone to use thus i love is so so much it is amazing

I love these serum. Gentle and lightweight. This serum absorbs quickly and doesn't irritate, good for sensitive skin. It really does boost hydration and leaves skin feeling good.

avis.titre: Simple and clean addition to night routine
avis.texte: Love how this product doesn't feel heavy on my skin, it doesn't have a bad smell. Wearing it nightly has become part of my routine. Easy application, will continue using to see results.

I loved this product!! I normally have dry skin, specially during the winter and this helped my skin feel moisturized during the night. I've been using it for the last couple of week and although my skin doesn't feel youthful, it doesn't feel dry or with a lack of collagen. Only downside is I wish it was a bigger bottle!

This night serum help hydrate the skin. Also helps with giving the skin a stronger barrier.makes look more vibrant and less dull. I been seeing my skin glow and it feels smooth after every application

avis.texte: I've really been enjoying this defense serum system! The PM formula is great and feels moisturizing on the skin without being sticky. I do use it with other skincare products such a hyaluronic acid lotion and it seems to play well with everything I've used so far. I have sensitive skin and did not experience any problems while using this serum. I have combination skin, so this really helped that dry flaky component without making me overly greasy. Great choice to add to any skincare routine looking for moisture and barrier protection!
It's a pretty good night cream. May have dry skin and it seemed to help that. It made my skin feel smooth and hydrated. Light scent which is nice for a night serum.
Love this skin care! I've been using it for about a month now and the difference is so unreal! It cleared up my skin and made the fine lines disappear for the most part. A little goes a long way!
I really like this serum. I wake up in the morning and my skin is nice and smooth. I highly recommend it. It applies so smooth and it's truly the best ever

I've been really impressed with this product and how quickly this repaired my skins barrier, my skin felt stronger and calmer over night. It gives me the smoothing and firming benefits I want without the irritation I normally get retinol. I love that its fragrance free and gentle on my sensitive acne prone skin. Its hydrates sooths redress and tone as well. The only thing I do have to say is the fine lines and wrinkles do take a couple weeks to be noticeable. I love the glass bottle and the size of it.

This is my first time trying a Cetaphil product, and I'm definitely not disappointed. I've been using their PM serum every night after my shower on a clean face and it's been a game changer for my skin care routine. The serum is super easy to apply and it feels so smooth on my skin. After using it, my skin feels really moisturized and I've definitely noticed some visible improvement, my skin looks brighter and has a glow I was missing. I also love that it's fragrance free which is a big plus for me in skincare products. Overall, I'm really happy with this serum and I'll continue to use it.

This serum has really transformed my skin for the best. I will be repurchasing both the morning and nighttime serums. My skin is more hydrated since I added these 2 serums to my routine. No scent and absorption happens fast.
